feature_protocol.central_pooling: equal mean of six per-position pocket means; each P3-P8 receives equal weight
feature_protocol.contact_rule: union across all five existing crystals of minimum heavy-atom distance <=4.5 Angstrom, restricted to canonical NetMHCpan34

pair.algorithm: numpy PCG64 Gaussian; reduced QR; positive R diagonal

token.algorithm: numpy PCG64 Gaussian; reduced QR; positive R diagonal

representations.R2: concatenate full-chain means A,B,C; no replacement by groove mean
representations.R3: P1-P9 then groove1-182; shared fixed 384-to-8 channel projection; flatten
representations.R3_pooled: same tokens, projection and dimensions as R3; tile peptide mean over nine positions and groove mean over182 before projection
representations.R4: groove mean for each P1-P9; layout [peptide,direction,128 channels]
representations.R5: contact mean per peptide position; layout [P1,P2,P9,mean(P3-P8),direction,128 channels]
representations.R5_position9x34: all P1-P9 x canonical34; layout [peptide,contact,direction,4 projected channels]
representations.R5_position9x34_pooled: same projection and dimensions as position9x34; per-peptide/direction contact-mask mean of projected channels tiled over34 positions
representations.R5_shuffled: same R5 pooling with fixed permutation of HLA contact membership; cardinality per peptide preserved

feature_protocol.scope_amendment: Fixed random projections bound fitting cost; never fitted on data or labels. This screen tests compressed positional channels and cannot exclude gains from full-channel or fitting-partition dimensional reduction.
feature_protocol.shuffling: fixed PCG64(seed) permutation of the 34 groove columns in the contact mask, applied before constrained pooling
